description: Each sentiment snapshot is its own unit, even when several snapshots point to the same transaction.

c.request: Link the sentiment data to transaction records on `transref` = `transreg`, dropping anything without a match and anything with no order type mix (`ordertypedist`), and look at institutional ownership (`instownpct`, ignoring missing values) against each transaction's order type mix. Take the cases whose ownership is strictly above the overall average ownership. In one unrounded row, give their average ownership, the average ratio of their ownership to the average ownership for their order type mix, and the average amount by which they exceed the overall average. Each sentiment snapshot is its own unit, even when several snapshots point to the same transaction.
c.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
    AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership FROM matched
), mix_averages AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_mix_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  AVG(m.instownpct) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(m.instownpct / ma.avg_mix_ownership) AS average_ratio_to_mix_average,
  AVG(m.instownpct - o.avg_ownership) AS average_excess_overall
FROM matched AS m
JOIN mix_averages AS ma ON ma.ordertypedist = m.ordertypedist
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership;

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction (`sentimentandfundamentals.transref` = `transactionrecord.transreg`), dropping snapshots without a match. Form one unit per sentiment snapshot (`sentreg`), labelled with its transaction's order type mix (`ordertypedist`), whose ownership is that snapshot's own institutional ownership (`instownpct`), so snapshots sharing a transaction count as separate units (missing values ignored), and leave out units with no order type mix. For each order type mix, take the average ownership of its units as the mix baseline. Then take the overall average ownership across all units, and keep only units whose ownership is strictly above it. Return one unrounded row with: the average ownership of the kept units, the average of each kept unit's ownership divided by its mix baseline, and the average amount by which the kept units' ownership exceeds the overall average.
a.sql:
WITH matched_units AS (
  SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist, s.instownpct AS ownership
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
unit_baselines AS (
  SELECT sentreg, ordertypedist, ownership,
         AVG(ownership) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_baseline,
         AVG(ownership) OVER () AS overall_average
  FROM matched_units
),
kept_units AS (
  SELECT ownership, mix_baseline, overall_average
  FROM unit_baselines
  WHERE ownership > overall_average
)
SELECT AVG(ownership) AS average_ownership,
       AVG(ownership / NULLIF(mix_baseline, 0)) AS average_mix_baseline_ratio,
       AVG(ownership - overall_average) AS average_excess_overall
FROM kept_units;

b.request: Treat each sentiment snapshot with a matching transaction and non-null `ordertypedist` as one row; exclude snapshots with null `instownpct`. Compute the overall average ownership across these rows and the average ownership for each order type mix across these rows. Among rows with ownership strictly above the overall average, return one unrounded row containing their average ownership, the average of each row’s ownership divided by its order type mix’s average ownership, and the average of each row’s ownership minus the overall average
b.sql:
WITH matched_rows AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
scored_rows AS (
  SELECT
    instownpct,
    AVG(instownpct) OVER () AS overall_avg_ownership,
    AVG(instownpct) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS order_type_avg_ownership
  FROM matched_rows
)
SELECT
  AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership,
  AVG(instownpct / order_type_avg_ownership) AS avg_ownership_to_order_type_avg_ratio,
  AVG(instownpct - overall_avg_ownership) AS avg_ownership_above_overall_avg
FROM scored_rows
WHERE instownpct > overall_avg_ownership

d.request: Link sentiment snapshots to transaction records on `transref = transreg`, dropping snapshots without a match or without an `ordertypedist` value. Treat each sentiment snapshot as a separate observation, even if multiple snapshots link to the same transaction. Ignoring missing `instownpct` values, select observations whose ownership is strictly above the overall average ownership. In one unrounded row, report their average ownership, the average ratio of their ownership to the average ownership for their order type mix, and their average excess over the overall average ownership.
d.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT s.instownpct, t.ordertypedist
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON s.transref = t.transreg
  WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
    AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
), order_type_avgs AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(instownpct) AS avg_ownership
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
), above_average AS (
  SELECT m.instownpct, m.ordertypedist, o.avg_ownership
  FROM matched AS m
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE m.instownpct > o.avg_ownership
)
SELECT
  AVG(a.instownpct) AS average_ownership,
  AVG(a.instownpct / ot.avg_ownership) AS average_ratio_to_order_type_average,
  AVG(a.instownpct - a.avg_ownership) AS average_excess_overall_average
FROM above_average AS a
JOIN order_type_avgs AS ot
  ON a.ordertypedist = ot.ordertypedist;
